messages:
maria: Heads-up: after canary of quant-profile int8-shift-v2 + sampler-affinity change, prefix cache hit rate dropped ~18% on canary hosts. Logs show many miss keys with small diffs.

jonathan: Which kernel roll did we flip? fused-attn-v3b? /cc @lee

lee: We rolled fused-attn-v3b + sampler affinity re-balance (scheduler change) at 02:05 UTC. Canary set: 10% traffic.

maria: Perf traces attached: small fingerprint deltas around padding/seed ordering. Example log snippet:

```
WARN kv-cache miss key=prefix:fingerprint=0x7f3a... len=32 seed=17 kernel_variant=fused-attn-v3b quant_profile=int8-shift-v2
```

sam: Could be key canonicalization: we normalize tokens before hashing but new kernel changed tokenization normalization (subword ordering)??

anita: I saw similar in profiling heatmap — early tokens' hashes shifted. Batching heuristics now group requests differently -> different prefix aggregates -> cache warming slower.

maria: Measured: baseline warmup 90s -> now 260s. Hit-rate per-tenant chart: drop at 02:10 correlates with rollout. Canary hosts show 0.72 -> 0.58 average.

lee: Any KV key collision counters? perf-bot maybe output?

perf-bot: kv-cache collisions: +2.1k in last 10m on canary nodes; key_entropy drop -6%.

jonathan: Can someone run this quick check: compute prefix hash for sample prompts on runner vs prod node? Command:

```
./tools/prefix-hash.py --model redwood-v1 --prompt-file sample.txt --seed 17
```

sam: I ran it — hashes differ when kernel_variant != 'reference' due to padding bytes in ctx embedding. Looks like fused-attn-v3b writes a pad flag bit.

maria: Hotfix idea: salt keys with kernel buildid to avoid collisions across variants, but that will reduce cross-variant warmup. Alternative: add canonicalization step in kernel output.

anita: We already have key canonicalization flag `normalize_prefix_tokens=true` in runtime config. On canary it was false by mistake. PR incoming.

lee: :thumbsup: prioritize. Rollback plan? revert sampler-affinity patch and restore previous kernel on canary.

jonathan: Rollback queued. Can we instead flip normalize_prefix_tokens=true first (less invasive) and observe? That would preserve cross-variant cache continuity.

maria: Agree. I'll patch canary config and re-run. Also will collect KV key histograms and warmup trace.

deploy-bot: config-toggle applied to canary pool at 02:28 UTC. monitor: hit-rate recovering to 0.69 after 10m.

sam: Nice. Also logging note: add `prefix_key_v1` and `prefix_key_v2` labels to traces for easier diffing.

lee: Create follow-up ticket to audit tokenization side-effects of fused-attn write path.

maria: Filed ticket INF-8792. Next: test quant-profile int8-shift-v2 with reference kernel to isolate quant change impact.

anita: I'll run A/B microbench with only quant change and report by EOD.

jonathan: Thanks all. Keep updates here. @perf-bot please post final numbers.
